verdict.rationale: Meltano is fully open-source and self-hostable ('Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever'; 'You host and manage everything on your own servers'), meaning there is no proprietary lock-in and users can inspect, modify, or migrate the entire pipeline configuration (project-as-code, version-controlled YAML). However, Meltano is a data-movement/orchestration tool, not a data store — it doesn't itself hold data to 'export'; data lands in whatever destination/loader the user chooses, and there's no explicit bulk-export or data-portability feature documented beyond choosing open destinations. Missing for 10: explicit data export/portability tooling, documentation of open interchange formats for extracted data, and independent evidence of users migrating data out.
